observations: Photo 0 shows a silver and black keyboard standing upright in a cluttered music store with boxes of other keyboards (Yamaha, etc.) in the background.
The front panel has 'Roland Fantom X8' clearly visible in vertical text on the top left.
The keyboard has 61 keys, a central LCD screen, and multiple control knobs and buttons.
Photo 1 shows the same keyboard from a top-down angle, placed on a concrete surface outdoors.
The 'Roland Fantom X8' branding is again visible on the top left of the panel.
The keyboard appears to have some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the silver casing.
No power cord, stand, or accessories are visible in either photo.
The screen is off in both photos, and no indication of functionality is shown.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly readable on the front panel in both photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not be functional (e.g., keys not working, screen not turning on, no sound output).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys being pressed, and sound output, or a photo of the screen lit up with menu navigation.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., internal components, key action, or circuitry issues).
risks.proof: A close-up video of the keys being pressed and released, and a photo of the back panel showing ports and power input.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential internal damage

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, cables, or original case).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on with keys being played and sound output.
Photo of the back panel showing all ports and power input.
Photo of any included accessories (power adapter, stand, cables, etc.).
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as a Roland Fantom X8, but functionality and condition cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. The keyboard must be proven to work and any accessories included must be shown before pricing can be determined.
